transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... I guess it's mostly just some issues at work. 

The main thing that pushed me to come in is... I just keep getting up from my workstation during the day. Even when I know I’m supposed to stay put and finish my claim reviews, I just don't. So... yeah. That's mostly it.
Do you feel anxious when you're sitting at your workstation?
No, not really. I just... get up. I don't think it's anxiety.
Do you feel like you have to get up from your workstation?

Um... I don't know about *have* to. It's just... like I was saying, I know I'm supposed to stay put. I have claim reviews to finish. But I just... end up walking away from my desk anyway. I don't really know why.
Do you feel like getting up from your workstation is something you do over and over?
I mean... I guess so. It happens a lot. I don't really keep track of how many times, but... yeah, it's pretty often.
Do you feel like you're trying to stop yourself from getting up from your workstation?
Not really... I don't think about it like that. I just sort of... find myself getting up. I don't really try to stop it.
Do you feel like you're getting up from your workstation for a specific reason or to achieve something?
No, not really. I just... I don't know. I'm not trying to do anything in particular. I just get up.
Do you feel like getting up from your workstation is something you can't control?
No... I wouldn't say that. It's not like I'm being forced to or anything. I just... end up doing it.
Do you feel like getting up from your workstation is something you do to make some kind of unpleasant feeling go away?
No... I don't think so. I'm not... trying to escape anything. I just get up.
Do you feel like you have any repetitive behaviors or thoughts outside of getting up from your workstation?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I do anything like that.
Do you often act on impulse?
No, not really. I don't think I'm a very impulsive person.
Do you often feel anxious or worried when you're not at work?
Um, no, not really. I don't think I worry too much when I'm off the clock. Just... normal, I guess.
Do you have thoughts that keep repeating in your mind?
No... not that I've noticed. I don't really get stuck on things like that.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety?

Um... yeah, I guess. Like, if I have to sit through a training or a long team meeting... I'm usually bouncing my leg or clicking my pen. Just sort of shifting around in my chair, even when I'm trying to look focused.
Do you usually feel restless or fidgety when you're just relaxing at home?
Um... no, not really. If I'm just at home... I don't think I do that. It's mostly just a work thing, I guess.
Do you feel restless or fidgety in other situations besides work?
Um... no, not really. Just... mostly when I'm stuck at the office, I think.
Do you feel anxious when you're feeling restless or fidgety at work?
Um... no. Not really anxious. Just... bored, I guess. I don't feel nervous or anything, I just... kind of want to get out of the chair.
Do you ever get up and walk away from things when you're not at work?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so. If I'm not at work, I usually just... stay where I am, I guess.
Do you think you get up from your workstation because you're trying to escape feeling bored?

Yeah... I guess so. Um... that's actually the main thing that pushed me to come in, really. I just... I keep getting up from my workstation during the day. Even when I know I'm supposed to just stay put and finish my claim reviews, I just... keep leaving.
Do you think you would still get up from your workstation if you were doing a task you enjoyed?
Um... I don't really know. I guess... maybe not? I haven't really paid attention to that. Most of what I do is just the claims, so... I'm not sure.
